cases.case_label: Germline SVA in BRCA1 intron (1.8 kb downstream of first coding exon)
cases.mechanism_detail: A germline SVA located 1.8 kb downstream of the first coding exon of BRCA1 (absent from 1000 Genomes) was found in an HRDetect-high TNBC with LOH of the wild-type allele and markedly reduced BRCA1 expression, proposed as a novel mechanism of BRCA1 abrogation.
cases.quote: Moreover, wild-type allele LOH was noted and BRCA1 expression was markedly reduced.
